[F001] F001 was already fully implemented from prior iterations, so this iteration was verification and evidence capture rather than new construction. I confirmed all four deliverables are in place and mutually consistent: `upgrade-releases.schema.json` (closed schema with `baseline_release`/`baseline_date` + ordered `releases[]`, closed `kind`/`severity`/command-`label` enums, and the full per-action field set), the Pydantic models (`UpgradeManifest`/`UpgradeRelease`/`UpgradeAction`/`UpgradeCommand`) carrying the cross-field invariants not expressible in JSON Schema (D021 required-probe, D029 required apply-command, D036 ordered apply+verify checklist, D030 id-uniqueness, D047 non-blank commands), and `load_release_manifest` resolving the manifest as a package-relative `importlib.resources` resource (D045) backed by `pyproject.toml` `package-data` so it ships in the wheel. The runtime model is byte-identical to the agent-conventions mirror, the packaged `data/releases.json` matches the authored `docs/upgrade/releases.json`, the agent-conventions VERSION is bumped to 1.14.0 with a matching CHANGELOG entry, and the seed manifest validates against both the JSON Schema and the Pydantic loader. The targeted suite is fully green — **29 passed** — covering every acceptance rejection case plus the off-cwd/off-git/installed-package resolution paths, and I captured the run under `evidence/F001-i0-release-manifest-tests.txt` (D048).
